title: DustTwin NDJSON envelope v1
description: One bounded UTF-8 JSON object per line, max4096 bytes. Device sampleMs records observations; host receive monotonic time drives watchdogs. Four ordered SPS30 PM1/PM2.5/PM4/PM10 channels: North,East,South,West. One SHT35. Runtime validation is in hardware/pi/protocol.py and firmware sources.

session.description: Host command session, echoed in ACK. New session clears outputs and requires arm.

commandId.description: ACK references an outstanding command sequence.
